description: This PHP source file defines the ProviderAPI class within the OrangeHRM OpenID authentication plugin. It provides REST API endpoints for managing OpenID Providers, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving provider details. It utilizes various traits and services for ORM, encryption, validation, and business logic related to OpenID providers.

classes.name: ProviderAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints to manage OpenID Providers within the OrangeHRM system. It supports listing all providers, creating new providers, updating existing ones, deleting providers, and retrieving a specific provider. It handles input validation, transaction management, and utilizes various traits and services for data persistence and business logic.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all OpenID providers with optional sorting and filtering parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new OpenID provider and associated extra details within a database transaction.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Internal method to save or update OpenIdProvider entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: saveProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Internal method to save or update additional provider details, including encryption of client secret if enabled.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new provider, including required fields and length constraints.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Generates a validation rule for the provider name, ensuring uniqueness, length, and string type.

methods.name: getOpenIdProviderCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an EntityUniquePropertyOption object to distinguish new provider creation, ignoring inactive status values.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove multiple providers by their IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete operation, primarily ensuring IDs are an array of positive integers.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve details of a specific provider by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single provider by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing provider's details within a transaction.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating provider data e.g., URL, client ID/Secret, status.
